summary: AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS is a dict mapping AuthSpec subclasses to default driver-kwargs converters. auth_to_driver_kwargs() dispatches on type(auth) and calls the registered mapper. Covers NoAuth, PasswordAuth, TokenAuth, JWTAuth, OAuth2Auth, and IAMAuth by default. AzureADAuth, KerberosAuth, ServiceAccountAuth, CertificateAuth, and OAuth1Auth have no defaults — their backend adapters handle them.
extension_points: AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS — extend dict with additional AuthSpec subclasses to add custom dispatch
lifecycle_notes: auth_to_driver_kwargs raises KeyError for unregistered types — backend adapters must handle those types themselves
